environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7.x application deployed on Apache Tomcat 9.0.30 behind an AWS Network Load Balancer (NLB, Layer 4). SQS messages are published by an external partner integration service with no input validation on message attributes. The application runs with default Tomcat connector settings (allowTrace=false but no header value sanitization on older Tomcat). No reverse proxy or WAF in front. Response headers are passed through directly to the client browser.
